Class SysMLConcern

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.occurrences.SysMLOccurrence
sysmlinjava.constraint.SysMLConstraint
sysmlinjava.requirements.SysMLRequirement
sysmlinjava.requirements.SysMLConcern
public final class SysMLConcern extends SysMLRequirement
SysMLinJava representation of the SysML concern. As a specialized type of requirement, the SysMLConcern includes most of the members of the SysMLRequirement with those members that are inappropriate for the concern not used.

    • csvFormatAttributes

      public static final String csvFormatAttributes
      String format for CSV import of concern. Requirement is defined completely in single line of text. Line is CSV (using vertical bars instead of commas) of single instance attributes, followed by kev-value strings for user-defined attributes and for each dependencies list. Example CSV for a concerns is as follows. 
      
	1.2.3.4|Title of the concern|Text spec of the concern|Functional|Demonstration|Medium|Proposed|1|R Lee|U Grant|myAtt1=[This is my firstAttribute],myAtt2=[This is my secondAttribute]|derivedFrom=[1.1, 4.2.1],verifiedBy=[FunctionalTestCase,PerformanceTestCase,InterfaceTestCase];
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • csvFormatUserDefined

      public static final String csvFormatUserDefined
      String format for CSV import of concern user-defined attributes that is in a bar-separated field in the CSV line. Field consists of a key-value string pair where the key is the attribute name and the value is a brackets-enclosed string. An example follows. 
      
	userAtt1=[This is a user-defined attribute],userAtt2=[This is another user-defined attribute]
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • csvFormatDependency

      public static final String csvFormatDependency
      String format for CSV import of concern dependency list that is in a bar-separated field in the CSV line. Field consists of a key-value string pair where the key is the dependency name and the value is a comma-separated set of names of the dependency target. An example follows. 
      
	derivedFrom=[1.1, 4.2.1],verifiedBy=[FunctionalTestCase,PerformanceTestCase,InterfaceTestCase]
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

  • Constructor Details

    • SysMLConcern

      public SysMLConcern(String identifier, String title, String constraintText, Optional<SysMLRequirementConstraintFunction> constraintFunction, Optional<Class<? extends SysMLOccurrence>> subject, List<Class<? extends SysMLStakeholder>> stakeholders, List<Class<? extends SysMLPart>> actors, List<SysMLConstraint> assumed, RequirementCategoryEnum category, List<Class<? extends SysMLOccurrence>> allocatedTo, List<SysMLVerificationMethodKind> verificationMethods, List<Class<? extends SysMLVerificationCase>> verifiedBy, List<SysMLHyperlink> supportingInformationLinks)
      Constructor for constraint-defined concern having no specific occurrence (occurrence must be set via explicit assignment after constructor)
      Parameters:
      identifier - concern's unique identifier
      title - concern's unique title
      constraintText - concern specified as simple text documentation for informal non-executable constraint
      constraintFunction - concern specified as formal executable constraint as lambda function
      subject - class of subject of this concern
      stakeholders - list of classes of stakeholders for this concern, if any
      actors - list of classes of actors involved in this concern, if any
      assumed - list of names of instances of SysMLConstraints that are assumptions for this concern
      category - concern's category
      allocatedTo - list of classes of parts, ports, actions, items to which this concern is allocated
      verificationMethods - concern's verification methods
      verifiedBy - list of classes of verification cases that verify this concern was satisfied
      supportingInformationLinks - list of names of instances of SysMLHyperlinks to information that supports this concern.
